title: Expression of Interest - Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Investment (Ministry of Health)
description: Government of Tanzania invites qualified local and international investors to submit EOIs for establishing pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities. Covers essential medicines, vaccines, APIs, medical consumables, devices and specialized formulations. Implemented through Green-Lane Approval System and Pharmaceutical Investment Acceleration Programme (PIAP). Rolling/accelerated review basis.
eligibility: Investors with pharmaceutical manufacturing expertise, WHO-GMP compliance track record, and financial capacity
